# Managing Artifact Lineage

## Core principle

Preserve immutable provenance, dependency edges, supersession, verification, and downstream invalidation. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- ephemeral notes with no downstream consumer
- independent artifacts with no dependency relation
